notes.title: Controller is now supported!
notes.content:
With our latest update (ver 1.0.1), you can now play Cake Invaders with a controller!
For those of you who love your controllers more than your mouse & keyboard, give it a try!

The game can be operated with Xbox, PlayStation, and Switch Pro controllers.
**The UI will be displayed for the Xbox controller. Please note!**

The operation of the controller is as follows.
[list]
[*]Aiming: Left stick or D-pad
[*]Fire bullets: A button or L/R triggers
[*]Switching bullets: X, Y, B buttons or L/R buttons
[/list]
Thank you for your continued support of Cake Invader.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1619080/
